name_rule: Letters, digits, - and _ only, up to 32 characters.
scan_hint: Scan this code with the WireGuard app, or download the file.
backup_intro: A backup is made after every change. It is one file: run it on a fresh server and everything comes back.
backup_none: No backup has been made yet.
backup_warning: A backup is not encrypted. It holds every key, so keep it private.
telegram_on: Every backup is sent to your Telegram chat.
telegram_help: Create a bot with @BotFather, send it any message, then paste its token here.
telegram_waiting: Send any message to @{bot} in Telegram, then press Connect again.
error_locked: Too many wrong passwords. Try again in a few minutes.
error_network: The server could not be reached.
s3_help: For R2, create a bucket and an API token with Object Read & Write on that bucket only. The newest 10 backups are kept.
s3_on: Every backup is uploaded to your bucket.
s3_connected: Connected. The first backup was uploaded as {key}.
password_help: At least 8 characters. Changing it signs out every other open session.
password_changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.
password_backup_failed: Password changed, but the backup to {destination} failed: {error}. That destination still has the old password; press Back up now once it is fixed.
error_short_password: The new password is shorter than 8 characters.
error_passwords_differ: The two new passwords do not match.
